transformation_expression.estimated_distance_m: double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm) >= 73.0 ? 0.01 : (double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm) >= 68.0 ? 0.01 + (73.0 - double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm)) * 0.014 : (double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm) >= 60.0 ? 0.08 + (68.0 - double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm)) * 0.025 : (double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm) >= 52.0 ? 0.28 + (60.0 - double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm)) * 0.045 : (double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm) >= 45.0 ? 0.64 + (52.0 - double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm)) * 0.080 : 1.20 + (45.0 - double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm)) * 0.120))))
transformation_expression.motion_description: !has(db.rows) || size(db.rows) == 0 ? 'Tag detectado por primera vez en lóbulo Keonn Advan-CP1' : (double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm) - double(db.rows[0].fields.prev_rssi) >= 1.5 ? 'Tag ACERCÁNDOSE a la antena Keonn (+ΔRSSI significativo)' : (double(payload.peak_rssi_dbm) - double(db.rows[0].fields.prev_rssi) <= -1.5 ? 'Tag ALEJÁNDOSE de la antena Keonn (-ΔRSSI significativo)' : 'Tag en posición ESTACIONARIA en el lóbulo'))
